title: narrow small garbage can
text: narrow small garbage can. A tiny bit darker gray than shows in the picture, but that works for me.  It's a thick, plastic, narrow garbage can.  The thickness (eyeballing around 1/4").  I wish the top edges were a bit more rounded - they are a tiny bit sharp - but I cover with a plastic liner, so that is minimized.  It is around 14 or 15" tall.  Works!
